items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Can you read any more of that, Ralph, on there?

ctx.x: It looks like a parman's uniform.

That says Montreal, Canada, Premier Theatre, November 26, 19 and 7. And tonight the two Johns. I guess that's a show or something else. Yes. Some other act. Can you read any more of that, Ralph, on there? Yeah. We'll read what it says on the drum.
It says the Nation's Big Revival of J.C. Stewart's. Let me see. There's a sign on the back that says positively. Oh, no smoking in this room. I couldn't read it very good.
